composio.description: Connects OpenCode to external apps and tools through MCP, enabling seamless integration with other services and workflows[cite: 2].

context7.description: Provides up-to-date library documentation to prevent outdated API usage and improve coding accuracy[cite: 2].

opencode-mem.description: Adds persistent memory for long-running coding sessions, allowing the AI agent to retain context across tasks[cite: 2].

envsitter-guard.description: Protects .env files and sensitive secrets from unsafe reads or edits by OpenCode agents[cite: 2].

oh-my-opencode-slim.description: Offers lightweight agent orchestration, background tasks, LSP/AST tools, and MCP support for enhanced workflow management[cite: 2].

opencode-worktree.description: Simplifies running isolated coding sessions using Git worktrees, improving project organization and version control[cite: 2].

opencode-notify.description: Sends native OS notifications when tasks are completed, keeping developers informed without constant monitoring[cite: 2].

dynamic-context-pruning.description: Reduces token usage by pruning stale context during long sessions, optimizing performance[cite: 2].

daytona-sandbox.description: Runs OpenCode sessions in isolated sandboxes and syncs changes back through Git branches, enhancing safety and reproducibility[cite: 2].
